name: Invoice Pair
office_task: Every morning, check our Harvest invoices against the ledger by invoice id, show each difference with both values, and fix one only once a named person accepts it.
systems_of_record: Harvest (issues the invoice and its id)
Balances (the ledger that records payment against the Harvest invoice id)

emits.write: the run's report into the shared reconciliation log: contract id, the key it joined on, the master per field, and the five counts (matched, within tolerance, mismatched, orphaned, corrected), the all-clear included
emits.readback: the log returns a report_id, and reading that id back returns the run with its contract id and counts; no id back means the run did not publish and the owner is told

emits.write: an exception on the Harvest invoice id naming the contract owner: an open difference with both values and the master's value awaiting acceptance, an orphan on one side, a difference over the threshold amount, a run over the mismatch rate, or a correction whose write returned no id
emits.readback: the exception desk returns an exception_id, and reading it back returns the Harvest invoice id, the reason and the exception_owner; no id back means nothing was raised and the run stops
